fakeModel.clock: per-instance monotonic clock and ordered manual timer callbacks; no global replacement
fakeModel.rpc: owned in-memory deferred promises only; no provider or transport
fakeModel.journal: instance callback; memory notes and injected failures
fakeModel.stderr: instance callback; no global process stderr replacement
fakeModel.disposal: owned deferreds actually settle; abort does not mean settlement; harness cleanup is separate from scenario checkpoints
fakeModel.unhandled: scoped native unhandledRejection observer with setImmediate checkpoint; removed finally

limitations: Does not execute the full F01 setup, receipt loop or final hook
